recovered_state: READFIELD 0.8.4 already had a verified phone work rail, exact source/cursor continuity, six task modes and READ↔LOCI bounded focus handoff.
Direct user feedback continued to target practical phone usability and what the surfaces are actually for, not a missing reader engine.
A concrete work gap remained: downloaded text-like artifacts still required paste/repo routing even though the reader kernel could already operate on them.
delta: Add direct FILE intake for downloaded text, Markdown, JSON, CSV, logs, YAML, source files and SVG; bytes remain session-local and are never uploaded by READFIELD.
Reuse the exact existing source/cursor/RSVP/VOICE/LOCI kernel; no new source authority or file store.
For ephemeral local/pasted sources, COPY FOCUS replaces COPY VIEW so the UI does not imply a durable URL can reconstruct missing bytes.
Keep the six-mode rail sticky on phone and make compositions explicit: SKIM→REVIEW, LISTEN→PULSE→VOICE, READ→LOCI→RETURN.
Add browser proof that a synthetic local Markdown File enters READFIELD, restores WORD/900 WPM focus, writes only sessionStorage metadata+bytes, and exposes COPY FOCUS.
boundaries: No persistent local media/file vault is added to READFIELD.
FIELD PULSE remains optional authority NONE.
LOCI remains a derived addressed course.
Local/pasted bytes are session-only and are not represented as durable repository/source URLs.
